title: Grade 3 French — Thu, Jun 04
description: Les couleurs — Day 4 of 5: Describing things with colours in sentences
subject: french

questions.question: What does 'J'ai un vélo rouge' mean?
questions.explanation: 'J'ai un vélo rouge.' = I have a red bike. 'J'ai' = I have, 'vélo' = bike.

questions.question: How do you say 'My dress is blue'?
questions.explanation: 'Ma robe est bleue.' = My dress is blue. 'Robe' is feminine → 'bleue'.

questions.question: What does 'Le chat noir dort' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le chat noir dort.' = The black cat sleeps. 'Noir' = black, 'dort' = sleeps.

questions.question: How do you say 'I like the colour green'?
questions.explanation: 'J'aime la couleur verte.' = I like the colour green.

questions.question: Complete: 'Mon stylo est ___' (My pen is black).
questions.explanation: 'Stylo' is masculine → 'noir'. 'Mon stylo est noir.' = My pen is black.

questions.question: What does 'Les fleurs sont jaunes' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Les fleurs sont jaunes.' = The flowers are yellow. 'Sont' = are, 'jaunes' (plural).

questions.question: How do you say 'a white house'?
questions.explanation: 'Une maison blanche.' = A white house. 'Maison' is feminine → 'blanche'.

questions.question: Complete: 'J'aime les pommes ___' (I like green apples).
questions.explanation: 'Pommes' is feminine plural → 'vertes'. 'J'aime les pommes vertes.'

questions.question: What does 'Mon sac est gris' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Mon sac est gris.' = My bag is grey. 'Sac' = bag, 'gris' = grey.

questions.question: How do you ask 'What colour is your shirt?' (ta chemise)
options: De quelle couleur est ta chemise?
questions.explanation: 'De quelle couleur est ta chemise?' = What colour is your shirt?

questions.question: Complete: 'La banane est jaune et la fraise est ___'
questions.explanation: 'La fraise est rouge.' = The strawberry is red. ('Et' = and.)

questions.question: What does 'une voiture verte et noire' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Une voiture verte et noire.' = A green and black car. Two colours joined by 'et' (and).

questions.question: How do you say 'The dog is brown'?
questions.explanation: 'Le chien est marron.' = The dog is brown. 'Marron' never changes form.

questions.question: Complete: 'Mes chaussures sont ___' (My shoes are white — feminine plural).
questions.explanation: 'Chaussures' is feminine plural → 'blanches'. 'Mes chaussures sont blanches.'

questions.question: Léa says: 'J'ai un chat noir et un chien blanc.' What does she have?
options: A black cat and a white dog
A white cat and a black dog
A black cat and a brown dog
questions.explanation: 'Un chat noir et un chien blanc' = a black cat and a white dog.
